project.name: Representative NC Family Law Matter
project.objective: Maintain an evidence-first case research and preparation workspace.
definition_of_done: Approved case architecture and source model are recorded.
constraints: Allegations remain distinct from verified facts

architecture.summary: Separate procedure, evidence, financial, parenting, discovery, and legal issue workstreams.
boundaries: Material case-strategy changes require a new architecture decision

risks: Disputed allegations may be mistaken for verified facts

routing.policy: Use low-cost tiers for bounded source organization and strong review for consequential legal analysis.

domain.posture: Fictional NC family-law research matter; source: synthetic docket fixture.
domain.objectives_and_deadlines: Organize synthetic records for research; no actual deadline or pending filing.
domain.evidence: Synthetic docket and order fixtures; preserve originals and distinguish allegations from verified facts.

workflow.policy: One bounded issue per task; link validation and independent review in a PR; accept only inside the approved foundation.
